ev.q: it was so highly valued that the Aztecs used cocoa beans as money

1.why: A段末句。cocoa beans being used to pay for things ↔ the Aztecs used cocoa beans as money。F段讲的是农民收入和价格，不是把可可豆当钱用。

ev.q: it remained expensive, since all the work of grinding the beans was done by hand

2.why: B段末句。costly ↔ expensive；reason ↔ since all the work of grinding the beans was done by hand。C段提到可可粉 much cheaper to produce，是“后来变便宜”，不是早期昂贵的原因。

ev.q: earlier attempts had failed because the water in ordinary milk spoiled the chocolate

3.why: D段。why using ordinary milk had not worked ↔ earlier attempts had failed because the water in ordinary milk spoiled the chocolate。E段只提到牛奶巧克力要加牛奶，没有解释失败原因。

ev.q: it could make a paste that could be pressed into a mould. The result was the first chocolate bar.

4.why: C段。how a solid chocolate product was first made ↔ adding cocoa butter back … a paste that could be pressed into a mould. The result was the first chocolate bar。E段描述的是今天的制作流程，不是“第一次”。

ev.q: the industry has been criticised for its use of child labour and for clearing forests to plant new trees

5.why: F段。damage to the natural environment ↔ clearing forests to plant new trees。同句的 child labour 是社会问题，不是环境问题，但证据都在F段。

ev.q: the beans and the white pulp around them are left in heaps or boxes for about a week to ferment

6.why: E段。piles or containers ↔ heaps or boxes；so that they can ↔ left … to ferment。dried 是下一步，不是放在堆里或箱子里的目的。

ev.q: packed into sacks and shipped to factories, where they are roasted

7.why: E段。sent to factories ↔ shipped to factories；and ___ ↔ where they are roasted。dried 在题干中已出现（after drying in the sun）。

ev.q: their thin shells are removed, leaving small pieces called nibs

8.why: E段。outer covering taken off ↔ their thin shells are removed；what remains is called ↔ leaving small pieces called nibs。不要填 shells（那是被去掉的部分）。

ev.q: which are ground into a thick liquid known as cocoa liquor

9.why: E段。crushed ↔ ground；a thick liquid called ↔ a thick liquid known as cocoa liquor。cocoa butter 是之后加入的原料之一，不是研磨可可碎粒得到的液体。

ev.q: Chocolate houses, similar to the coffee houses of the time, opened in London in the 1650s.

10.why: B段。first opened in the middle of the seventeenth century ↔ opened in London in the 1650s（17世纪50年代即17世纪中叶）。G（起初把可可当药）说的是欧洲人对可可的看法，主语不同。

ev.q: developed a press that squeezed most of the cocoa butter out of the beans

11.why: C段。took most of the fat out of the beans ↔ squeezed most of the cocoa butter out of the beans；B段说明 cocoa butter 就是可可豆里的天然脂肪（natural fat）。E（1847年做出第一块巧克力）是 Fry 公司，不是 van Houten。

ev.q: using condensed milk produced by his neighbour Henri Nestlé

12.why: D段。provided an ingredient ↔ condensed milk produced by … Henri Nestlé；the first milk chocolate ↔ Daniel Peter … succeeded in making milk chocolate。做出牛奶巧克力的是 Daniel Peter，Nestlé 提供的是炼乳。

ev.q: a machine called a conche, which stirred warm chocolate for many hours, and in some cases for several days

13.why: D段。made chocolate smoother ↔ produced the smooth chocolate；by stirring it for a long time ↔ stirred warm chocolate for many hours … several days。
